_comment: Real Alibaba Cloud Model Studio bill, read from the console Cost Overview page (Billing Overview -> List, Group By Model) on 2026-08-06 by Claude Opus 5. Account 4320188, region China (Beijing), workspace Default. Dates are Alibaba BILLING dates, which follow China Standard Time (UTC+8), not Pacific. Amounts are USD 'Amount Due' including rounding adjustments and tax. This file is the historical floor for the tracker: the collector merges live BSS OpenAPI data on top of it and never lets a total fall below what is recorded here.
source: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio console, Cost Overview, months 2026-04 through 2026-08
notes: July total 128.35 includes 9.23 of tax, folded into the 2026-07-02 daily row.
April includes videoretalk lip-sync, which is video work and is counted as video.
No month mixes video and text: video ran April through July, Qwen text only on billing day 2026-08-06.
MoMA's own ds_ledger reported only 108.75 lifetime for DashScope against a real 217.13 of video, so the ledger under-reports by roughly half and must not be used as the video source.
